title: Zarlio InvoiceLayout settings (schema_version 1)
description: Allowlisted, versioned layout settings stored on InvoiceLayout and snapshotted at issuance. Everything not listed here is rejected server-side. Protected invariants (QR at physical upper-left, required blocks always visible, essential item/total data never hidden) are enforced by the renderer and by the conditional rules below. Status: proposed contract for Phase 1 implementation.

template_id.description: simple_readable = «ساده و خوانا» (also the fixed Free layout); shop = «فروشگاهی»; ledger = «حساب طلا و ریال» (debit/credit columns for gold 750-grams and money, like bazaar gold-shop software).

blocks.description: Business-information blocks. Order within an area follows array order. Required kinds shop_name, contact_primary and address must appear exactly once and be visible.

visible.description: Rendering also requires the invoice.shop_logo capability snapshot and an uploaded validated raster logo; otherwise the Zarlio mark is used on Free and nothing on Basic/Professional.

columns.description: Column order. name and amount are mandatory; weight_g and purity are mandatory whenever the invoice contains a GOLD row; weight_g, purity, weight_750 and unit_rate are mandatory whenever it contains a GOLD_IN row (gold received from the customer) (renderer re-adds them if omitted). description, unit_rate, wage, profit and vat are optional. Changing columns never changes any amount.

show_component_breakdown.description: Show metal/wage/profit/VAT lines for GOLD rows under the items. The payable total with its unit is always shown.

text.description: Public end note printed on every invoice. Internal notes never flow here.

signature_box.description: Empty seller stamp/signature and buyer signature boxes. Implies no electronic or legal signature.

accent.description: Accent for the header rule and table head only. ink=#15171A, gold_deep=#8A5A00, emerald=#0B3B2E, burgundy=#4A1326; all pass 4.5:1 on white and print black-and-white safely. Light gold is never allowed as text.

margins.description: normal ≈ 12 mm, narrow ≈ 8 mm; both keep the QR quiet zone and never push the QR off the first-page header.

repeat_header.description: Compact header (shop name + invoice number) on pages after the first.

version.description: Optimistic concurrency version of the stored settings; server increments on save and rejects stale writes.

$comment.description: Free-text note for humans; ignored by the renderer.

allOf.description: name and amount columns are mandatory.

kind.description: contact_primary renders the landline when a valid one exists, otherwise the business mobile (never hidden). contact_mobile_extra additionally shows the business mobile next to a landline. social requires ref = ShopProfile social entry id; one block per entry.

ref.description: Entry id for social blocks; omitted for all other kinds.

align.description: Physical alignment inside the area. The physical upper-left of the header is reserved for the verification QR: a left-aligned header block renders beside/below the QR, never over it.
